name: Runner Extras - Report Layout By Name
brief: Proves a report layout selected BY NAME (ReportLayoutSelection.SetTempLayoutSelectedName) resolves to the declared layout instead of failing with NavNCLReportNoLayoutException.
description: A report declaring two named rendering layouts of different Type (RDLC default + Custom non-default). The suite asserts (a) the Report Layout List system virtual table (2000000231) lists BOTH declared layouts with their real Name / Layout Format / MIME Type, and reports nothing for an undeclared name; (b) selecting the non-default Custom layout by name drives the render down a DIFFERENT processor fork than the RDLC default, which is the observable proof that the NAME (not just the report default) decided the layout; (c) selecting an undeclared name still fails loudly. Rendering itself is out of scope - the assertions stop at layout resolution.
